en.headline: Diabetes, in 30 seconds
body: This is a SingHealth video about living with diabetes.
A short walk after meals lowers sugar.
Fill half your plate with vegetables.
Look at your feet every day for cuts.
en.passage: [0:18] A short walk after meals helps to lower blood sugar.

ms.headline: Kencing manis, dalam 30 saat
body: Ini video SingHealth tentang hidup dengan kencing manis.
Berjalan sekejap selepas makan menurunkan gula.
Isi separuh pinggan anda dengan sayur.
Lihat kaki anda setiap hari untuk luka.
ms.passage: [0:18] A short walk after meals helps to lower blood sugar.

zh.headline: 30秒了解糖尿病
body: 这是SingHealth讲怎样和糖尿病一起生活的视频。
饭后散步一会儿能降血糖。
每天看看脚上有没有伤口。
zh.passage: [0:18] A short walk after meals helps to lower blood sugar.
